title: Condensed realization of a finite-stage Weil complex and its Frobenius operators
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $Y_0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$. Let $K_E\in D^b_{c,\mathrm W}(Y,E)$ be an $E$-Weil complex [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], let $F$ be its global geometric Frobenius on $R\Gamma_c(Y,K_E)$ [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology, def-weil-global-geometric-frobenius], and for $n\ge1$, $x\in Y_0(\mathbf F_{q^n})$ and any geometric point $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}k\to Y$ over $x$ (obtained from any $k_0$-embedding $\mathbf F_{q^n}\hookrightarrow k$) let $K_{E,\bar x}$ and $F_x^{(n)}$ be the stalk complex and the local operator formed at $\bar x$ by the construction of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] (which applies because $g_Y^n\bar x=\bar xg_s^n$ for every such embedding). There is a functorial realization of this finite-stage datum as a Weil object $(K_\Omega,\phi_\Omega)$ in the bounded constructible module-object category $D^b_c(Y)[[\operatorname{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)]]$ [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible, sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed] for the model Frobenius [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. For every $n\ge1$ there are specified isomorphisms between the condensed compact-support object and the finite-matrix realization of $R\Gamma_c(Y,K_E)$, and, for every $x\in Y_0(\mathbf F_{q^n})$ and every geometric point $\bar x$ over $x$, between the stalk at the model-Frobenius fixed point corresponding to $x$ and the finite-matrix realization of $K_{E,\bar x}$ [lem-zl-point-realization-coefficient-comparison, lem-zl-condensed-point-supertrace], that intertwine the model-Frobenius globalOperator and stalkFrobenius [nt-assume-trace-formula] with the scalar extensions of the corresponding E-stage operators $F^n$ and $F_x^{(n)}$. The fixed points of the model Frobenius iterate are exactly the points indexed by $Y_0(\mathbf F_{q^n})$ [thm-trf-frobenius-fixed-points]. If the displayed E-complexes are bounded finite-dimensional, the realized condensed global and stalk objects have right duals in $D^b_c(\operatorname{Spec}k)[[\operatorname{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)]]$, as objects isomorphic to finite-matrix realizations [lem-zl-condensed-point-supertrace]. This is a coefficient and operator comparison only: it asserts no Grothendieck--Lefschetz trace identity.
